title: Grand Armory
html:
The main entrance of the Grand Armory.

The Grand Armory is a large arsenal that most commonly spawns on Selector. The Grand Armory is quite spacious, having large open rooms and five floors with stairs and elevators connecting them. The main entrance is always accompanied by two lamps on either side of the door.

> Rooms

  • Missile Container - A platform that spawns close to the main entrance with a missile in a container. This container can be opened after completing a Secondary Objective.
  • Server Rooms - Enclosed rooms with a light on top of them, often containing lockers and lots of scrap. These rooms have a lever that can be turned off to shut down the power to that room, making the light on top green instead of yellow. This can be used as a helpful indicator that a room has already been looted.
  • Shipping Containers - Some shipping container doors can be opened. These containers are typically on the ground floor.
  • Cold Storage - A cold storage room where scrap can spawn. Can connect to either a dead end with a possible Lurker at the end of it or can connect to The Exterminator event.
  • Liquid Area - A large portion of the armory that has various platforms connected over liquid. A larger Server Room typically spawns in this area.
  • Charging Station - A room similar to a Server Room but with a powered off apparatus outside of it and a charge station inside of it. Typically spawns in the Liquid Area.
  • Toxic Apparatus - A green apparatus that typically spawns on a grated platform, typically in the Liquid Area. It is worth ▮280, is two-handed, and weighs 31lbs. Taking the apparatus will trigger a Lockdown.

> Interior Features

  • Elevator - An elevator near the main entrance can be used to go between different floors with the push of a button.
  • Breaker Box - When turning off multiple switches on the breaker box, the lights will turn red and begin to play alarm sound. This primarily makes it easier to find Server Rooms, and the light will remain green if the power is turned off to that room even with the breaker box off.
  • The Liquid in the Grand Armory changes based on the moon it spawns on.

> Hazards

  • Lockdown - when the apparatus is pulled, the separate platform it is on, if any, will fall into the liquid below. All fire exit doors will become locked and only accessible via the exterior, meaning the only way to get out is through the main entrance. The ceiling will be revealed to have spikes on it and begin to fall slowly, sometimes dropping a significant distance or increasing and decreasing in speed. If a player comes into contact with the top of the ceiling, they will be crushed for 999 damage. Once the ceiling has reached the floor, it will shortly rise back up and make the interior accessible again. However, the fire exit doors will remain locked.
  • Swinging Hook - A hook that swings back and forth, dealing 25 damage to any player that comes into contact with the sharp point.
  • Lurker - A hazard that sits behind a set of double doors, occasionally peeping out. If a player is in its line of sight, the doors will open revealing a flamethrower that will rapidly deal 10 damage per hit to players and entities.
  • Liquid - Pools of hazardous liquid that emit a soft glow. What this liquid does varies. For example, the regular acid pools deal 999 damage per hit to a player that falls into them. Some act as quicksand. Regardless, falling into them usually results in death.

> Secondary Objectives

The Missile Container that holds the reward.

One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn in the Missile Container.

Radio Signals

If there is a red light on the satellite dish, players need to tune the radio frequencies. This can be done by finding cases with a dial on them inside Server Rooms with a small yellow light on them. The dial must be repeatedly turned until the sounds match each other and players must hit the green button when they match.

Once all three frequencies are properly tuned, a sound effect will play and players can return to the Missile Container to get their reward.

Code Input

If the numbered button panel has a red light, players must find the Charging Station in the interior. Inside will be a sticky note on a cabinet that says a four digit code. Players can then return to the Missile Container, input the correct code, and get their reward.

Communications

If both lights on the main panel are red, players must find a Shipping Container with a small yellow light on it. Inside that container will be a board of morse code and a device to input a code. Players must listen to the morse code sequence and determine what the code is by following the board. A circle indicates a short beep and a dash indicates a long beep. One strategy players can use is to only count and listen for when long beeps happen, as they are easier to discern from multiple short beeps.

After inputting the correct code, players can press an emergency button to the right. A sound effect will play and players can return to the Missile Container to get their reward.

The reward is randomized, but the chance for a more valuable reward is increased by how early in the day players complete the objective and is influenced by the vanilla luck system. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. Code Input is considered Easy difficulty and has a 1.0x multiplier, Radio Signals is considered Medium difficulty and has a 1.15x multiplier, and Communications is considered Hard difficulty and has a 1.4x multiplier. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section.

> Event: The Exterminator

The Exterminator revealing itself.

The Exterminator can randomly generate connected to a Cold Storage room. At the end of a grated hallway lies a caged area with five Skinned Thumpers hanging from hooks and an Advanced nightstick on the ground. Once any player enters far enough into this room, a door will abruptly shut behind them, the lights will flicker, the center thumper will be slammed to the ground, and all thumpers will be risen up into the ceiling.

The Exterminator will then reveal itself at the front of and outside of the arena, resembling a much larger Lurker. Shortly afterward, a Skinned Thumper will be dropped into the arena. This is a variant of the Thumper with 12hp. The Advanced nightstick can be swung as a weapon with the additional property of stunning enemies for a short duration, making fighting the Skinned Thumper significantly easier. When a Skinned Thumper is killed, another Skinned Thumper will shortly be dropped into the arena and players must kill four of them in total.

While the player fights the Skinned Thumpers, The Exterminator will be moving around the arena and attempting to attack players with four different attacks:

  • Flamethrower - The Exterminator will open up one claw near the roof and begin spraying a flamethrower that tracks a player. It will rapidly deal 5 damage per hit to any player caught in it.
  • Dual Flamethrower - The Exterminator will open up two claws near the roof and begin spraying a flamethrower from both, moving in a straight line across the arena. These flamethrowers will rapidly deal 10 damage per hit to players.
  • Fan - The Exterminator will begin spinning a larger claw and slowly lowering it into the center of the arena, although it also loosely tracks a player. This fan will deal 999 damage per hit to any player hit by it while its spinning.
  • Saws - The Exterminator will lower three sets of giant saws into and at the edge of the arena, moving them across the arena in a straight line. Any player that touches the blades will take 999 damage per hit.

If players successfully kill all four Skinned Thumpers while surviving The Exterminator, the fifth and larger Skinned Thumper, now engulfed in flames, will shortly be dropped into the arena. It will ignore players and immediately run straight into the door that shut behind players when they entered the arena, dying and slightly popping it open. The Exterminator will begin one final attack by opening up five claws at the front of the arena and spewing flames from all of them, slowly moving them toward the back of the arena. These flames rapidly deal 80 damage per hit and players must interact with the door to open it and escape the arena before these flames reach them.

The reward for this event is the Advanced nightstick players used to fight the Skinned Thumpers, ranging from ▮192 to ▮329. The primary appeal of this scrap is that it doubles as both a weapon and a stunning tool. It has approximately a 2s base stun duration, slightly better than a Radar-booster's stun, and also weighs significantly less than a Shovel at only 2lbs. However, it can not be put in a Belt bag and both its value and rarity as an event reward makes losing it significantly more impactful.
